messages:
sam: Quick flag - uptick in fncall validation rejects on eu-west dedicated nodes. Customers routed to degen and seeing surprise token charges. anyone on this?
ivy: drop the alert or query?
sam: `fncall.validator_reject_rate{region=\"eu-west\"}` -> 0.72% (5m). top routes: tool-invoke, compose. impacted tenants: t-42, t-omega.
opsbot: Alert: fncall.validator_reject_rate > 0.5% for eu-west (5m).
diego: example errors? shape vs enum?
sam: log sample: `validation_error: \"expected object for tool_kwargs; got array\" payload: [\"a\",\"b\"] route: tool-invoke-v3 validator=v8.2`
marta: caller contract break - positional array used for tool args. gateway currently emits billable_tokens on accept (pre-validate). that's why they see charges.
diego: short term: have gateway add `validation_result=reject` and `billable=false` to usage events so billing can zero-rate them. low-risk change to event payload.
ivy: console request: add a Validation rejects panel (count, pct) per-account + top reasons + sanitized last-50 payload viewer. support needs evidence for credits.
marta: long term: add a per-tenant `soft_validate` rollout flag (permissive/coerce/strict) to ease migrations. default strict for hosted.
diego: telemetry: emit `fncall.validation_rejects_total{route,account,reason,validator}` and trace tag `validation_reason`. sample payload sink to S3 at 0.5%, ramp to 5% for accounts >100 rejects/hr.
sam: ops question: if we stop billing rejects, will quota dashboards break for customers expecting attempt counts?
marta: preserve `fncall.attempts_total` for attempt counting and keep `fncall.billable_tokens` only for accepted flows. that separates usage vs billing.
ivy: UX: toggle should show warning and create an audit entry; provide one-click rollback for tenant-facing validator setting.
deploy-bot: Canary: gateway/1.8.0 -> eng-dedicated in 4m (manual approval required).
diego: owners: sam -> customer outreach + support template, diego -> gateway tagging + telemetry PR, marta -> billing pipeline change, ivy -> console panel + UX copy.
sam: thanks. i'll kick off support comms and loop finance for retro credits if impact > $10/account. ping me if rate >1% for 10m and i'll page SRE. :thumbsup:
billingbot: Note: will escalate to finance if impacted_charge_total > 10.00 USD per account.
